works.analysis: The request includes supplies and services, which are outside the mandate for works-only contracts. Works must be separated from other contract types and kept below the EU threshold with a performance guarantee and a competitive procedure.

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: For the €10 million procurement budget, supplies will be allocated 30% (€3 million). The services and works proposals were rejected due to out-of-scope and constraint violations. Therefore, the remaining 70% will be reallocated as follows: services 40% (€4 million) and works 30% (€3 million). The award criterion for supplies will be best price-quality ratio with weights of price 60% and quality 40%. The services and works will be reassessed and reallocated in a separate process to ensure compliance with the Directive's principles.
